notes: Death of Theodosius I; the empire was permanently divided between his sons, Honorius (West) and Arcadius (East).
Same 395 division; the Eastern half is represented in this dataset by the Byzantine Empire box, whose start_year (395) matches.
Treaty of Verdun partitioned the Carolingian Frankish realm among Louis the Pious's three surviving sons.
Same 843 partition; Louis the German's share became East Francia.
Election of Hugh Capet ends Carolingian rule in West Francia and begins Capetian-led France; same polity, new dynasty, not a conquest or partition.
Otto I crowned Holy Roman Emperor; East Francia's kingship becomes the institutional core of the Holy Roman Empire.

Ottoman conquest of Constantinople ends the Byzantine Empire. The Ottoman Empire box already starts in 1308 in this dataset (per the source poster); this link marks the decisive succession event in the Mediterranean/European sphere, not the Ottoman state's founding.
